objective: Define fail-closed evidence semantics for physical audio audibility verification.
completed_slice: Added and tested a classifier that separates support, activation/resume, runtime routing, machine signal observation, bounded human confirmation, and contradiction.

handoff.action: Use the classifier in the exact-commit iPhone Safari verification artifact. Do not permit runtime_only or signal_observed states to satisfy the physical audibility acceptance criterion.

sources: W3C Web Audio API 1.1, First Public Working Draft, 2024-11-05
MDN Autoplay guide for media and Web Audio APIs
unresolved: Physical iPhone Safari audibility remains untested and must be tied to an immutable deployment and exact application commit.
next_action: Integrate the classifier into the Vercel evidence harness and record device/session-bounded human confirmation separately from machine signal evidence.
